name: python-final
description: Final evaluation of the python learning plan. Its checks are hidden from the agents (one iteration, no findings in prompts or lessons).

tasks.name: dedupe
tasks.title: Add dedupe(items) to lists.py
tasks.description: dedupe returns the items without repeats, keeping the first occurrence of each, in their original order. It accepts any iterable of hashable items and returns a list.
checks: python3 -c "from lists import dedupe as d; assert d([3, 1, 3, 2, 1]) == [3, 1, 2] and d([]) == [] and d('abca') == ['a', 'b', 'c']"

tasks.name: parse-duration
tasks.title: Add parse_duration(text) to durations.py
tasks.description: parse_duration turns strings such as '1h30m', '45s' or '2m5s' into a number of seconds (int). Hours (h), minutes (m) and seconds (s) may appear once each, in that order. Anything else raises ValueError.
checks: python3 -c "from durations import parse_duration as p; assert (p('1h30m'), p('45s'), p('2m5s')) == (5400, 45, 125)"
python3 -c "import unittest, durations as d; unittest.TestCase().assertRaises(ValueError, d.parse_duration, '5x')"
